[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/indeed-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/indeed-scraper.md)

Scraper de exemplo que coleta dados de vagas de emprego do Indeed.com, escrito em Python com a API de web scraping do [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/). Faz parte do [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.pt-BR.md).

- **Guia:** [How to Scrape Indeed.com (2025 Update)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-indeedcom)
- **Código:** [`indeed.py`](indeed.py) · **Execução de exemplo:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Testes:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Saída de exemplo:** [Job pages](results/jobs.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## O que ele extrai

- Busca de vagas do Indeed para encontrar vagas de emprego
- Páginas de vagas do Indeed para conjuntos de dados de vagas

## Funções

- `scrape_search(url, max_results=1000)` → `List[Dict]`: Scrape Indeed.com search for job listing previews
- `scrape_jobs(job_keys)`: scrape job page

As funções são `async`: execute-as com `asyncio.run(...)` ou use `await`.

### Exemplo

As entradas são os exemplos de [`run.py`](run.py) (listas longas encurtadas):

```python
import asyncio
import indeed


async def main():
    search = await indeed.scrape_search("https://www.indeed.com/jobs?q=python&l=Texas", max_results=10)
    jobs = await indeed.scrape_jobs(["3b22219beccc75fb", "67ac05ed425cf599"])


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Saída

As funções retornam dicionários e listas simples. Campos da saída de exemplo (chaves de primeiro nível do primeiro item):

- [`results/jobs.json`](results/jobs.json): `description`, `jobType`, `companyImagesModel`, `companyName`, `companyOverviewLink`, `companyReviewLink`, `companyReviewModel`, `employerActivity`, `employerProvidedOccupations`, `employerResponsiveCardModel`, `encryptedFccCompanyId`, `formattedLocation`, `hideRating`, `isCondensedRating`, `isDesktopApplyButtonSticky`, `isSimpleVjImproveActive`, `isSimplifiedHeader`, `jobNormTitle`, `jobTitle`, `jobTypes`, `location`, `openCompanyLinksInNewTab`, `parentCompanyName`, `preciseLocationModel`, `ratingsModel`, `recentSearch`, `remoteLocation`, `remoteWorkModel`, `salaryCurrency`, `salaryMax`, `salaryMin`, `salaryType`, `subtitle`, `tagModels`, `taxonomyAttributes`, `viewJobDisplay`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `adBlob`, `adId`, `advn`, `appliedOrGreater`, `applyCount`, `assistedApply`, `autoSourcerJob`, `bidPosition`, `blobKey`, `clickLoggingUrl`, `company`, `companyBrandingAttributes`, `companyIdEncrypted`, `companyRating`, `companyReviewCount`, `createDate`, `d2iEnabled`, `displayTitle`, `dradisJob`, `employerAssistEnabled`, `employerResponsive`, `encryptedFccompanyId`, `encryptedResultData`, `enhancedAttributesModel`, `enticers`, `expired`, `extractTrackingUrls`, `extractedSalary`, `fccompanyId`, `featuredCompanyAttributes`, `featuredEmployer`, `featuredEmployerCandidate`, `feedId`, `formattedLocation`, `formattedRelativeTime`, `gatedVjp`, `hideMetaData`, `highVolumeHiringModel`, `hiringEventJob`, `hiringMultipleCandidatesModel`, … (70 mais)

## Configurações do Scrapfly

`BASE_CONFIG` em [`indeed.py`](indeed.py) contém as configurações padrão das requisições; veja a [documentação da Scrape API](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: o [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker) do Scrapfly, que contorna proteções anti-bot
- `country` = `"US"`: país do proxy

## Início rápido

Requer Python 3.10+ e [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/indeed-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # em https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # scraping de exemplo, salva a saída em ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # os testes deste scraper
```

Testes: `test_search_scraping`, `test_job_scraping`; para executar um, use `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` e os testes fazem scraping do site real, por isso consomem créditos do Scrapfly.
